curation.lead:
Stephen K. Bannon served as White House Chief Strategist (January–August 2017) and earlier as Vice President of Cambridge Analytica (June 2014–August 2016). A review of the Cambridge Analytica–SCL intelligence chain points to the Epstein relationship being a separate political-and-media track rather than an operational use of CA capabilities [Finding #1242]. Between January 2018 and Epstein's arrest in July 2019, Bannon became a frequent correspondent of Jeffrey Epstein; the email corpus and calendar entries record more than 160 emails and at least 17 in-person meetings at 9 East 71st Street over that window [Finding #99]. The introduction was brokered in November 2016 by Richard Kahn of HBRK Associates, who wrote to Brock Pierce that "if I were you, I would suggest to steve bannon that he talk privately with jeffrey, as you know jeffrey knows more about international finance than anyone on trumps team, by a long way" [Finding #1235][EFTA02669093]. The channel ran initially through Michael Wolff, who forwarded White House information from Bannon to Epstein during 2017 — including Trump's interest in the Saudi deputy crown prince [Finding #103][EFTA02376015] and Rupert Murdoch's campaign against Bannon during the August 2017 West Wing power struggle [Finding #144][EFTA02641325].

Across 2018–2019 the correspondence covered four recurring streams. Bannon relayed White House personnel intelligence, including Hope Hicks's potential indictment and Jared Kushner's security-clearance downgrade [Finding #106][EFTA02517841]. Epstein reciprocated with geopolitical commentary on Gulf states, Bolsonaro's Brazil, and cyber-intelligence tradecraft including a detailed explanation of zero-day exploit markets [Finding #1232][EFTA02505281]. Epstein orchestrated introductions to Ehud Barak, Terje Rod-Larsen, Miroslav Lajcak (then President of the UN General Assembly), Kathryn Ruemmler, Noam Chomsky, Tom Pritzker, Jabor Al Thani, and Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri [Finding #121][Finding #128]. Epstein tracked Bannon's European populist project — meetings with Matteo Salvini in Milan and coordination with Benjamin Harnwell's Dignitatis Humanae Institute in Rome — in real time [Finding #125][EFTA02600289].

The financial dimension included a $100,000 invoice Epstein told Bannon to send through Darren Indyke in June 2019 for a documentary image-rehabilitation project, funded travel to Epstein's USVI island and Bergen, Norway via AmEx Centurion, and Apple Watches delivered through Lesley Groff to both Bannon and his son Sean [Finding #115][EFTA01615902][EFTA02285032][Finding #142]. On June 3, 2019 — five weeks before Epstein's arrest — their iMessage exchange turned to Prince Andrew and George Nader; Bannon told Epstein "Cant believe nobody is making u the connective tissue," and Epstein described Nader's then-pending proceedings as "He was not extradited. He was duped. There is his bail hearing today. Pre trial detention. Currently in Brooklyn" [Finding #111][Finding #1227][EFTA01615902]. On December 6, 2018 — the day William Barr was nominated as Attorney General — Epstein emailed Bannon "do you know bill barr. CIA" under the subject line "Re: Alex Acosta update | Power Line." Since leaving the White House, Bannon was indicted in 2020 on federal fraud charges tied to the We Build the Wall crowdfunding campaign (pardoned by Trump in January 2021), indicted in 2022 in the New York state equivalent (pending), and convicted in 2022 of two counts of contempt of Congress relating to the January 6 select committee subpoena; the contempt conviction was vacated by the D.C. Circuit in 2024.
curation.system_role: Bannon illustrates how a figure with recent proximity to executive power can transact that access as a commodity after departure — trading White House and Republican-orbit intelligence, European political introductions, and media production services with a private financier in exchange for geopolitical access, a contact network, and funded projects. The documented 2018–2019 correspondence with Epstein shows post-White House influence being privately monetized and routed through media and philanthropy vehicles rather than lobbying registrations.

sections.title: Information Exchanged
sections.content:
The 2018–2019 correspondence contains two recurring information flows. Bannon described White House personnel dynamics to Epstein in near real time [Finding #106]. On February 28, 2018, Bannon wrote "I think hope maybe getting indicted" about Hope Hicks, forwarded a Politico item on Jared Kushner's security-clearance downgrade, and reported that he was "To have breakfast with Jared" [Finding #106][EFTA02517841]. Epstein replied the same day with a geopolitical note: "MBS coming to wash 19th. bibi jared donald. all need a win" [EFTA02517841]. On December 22, 2018, Bannon wrote "jared and ivanka need to go" and sent mocking material about Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin [Finding #139][EFTA02611328]. Epstein had been discussing Bannon with other Trump-orbit contacts since February 2017, when he asked Nicholas Ribis whether Trump would "turn on bannon soon as bannon is getting too much attention and power" [Finding #139][EFTA02496013].

The reciprocal flow from Epstein covered Gulf politics, Brazilian elections, and European affairs [Finding #1257]. An October 8–9, 2018 iMessage exchange (HOUSE_OVERSIGHT_027445) covers Bolsonaro's then-pending Brazil election (Epstein: "if you are confident of a win, might be good for the brand if you were seen there"), Nikki Haley's UN resignation (Bannon: "She is going to primary trump"), Paul Singer's reported posture toward the House races, and the aftermath of the Jamal Khashoggi killing, where Epstein wrote that Saudi foreign-minister-era figure "HBJ" was "excited about kashoggi issue. Highlighting out of control Saudis" [Finding #1257]. The same thread contains a shorthand summary — "Yemen / Iran / oil - zamel, nader. Prinz / 1 mdb / deripaska" — and Epstein's characterization of Gulf leaders as "High school girls. Easily insulted. Vindictive- superstitious- petty/ grand and petulant" [Finding #1257].

On July 2, 2018, Bannon asked about DefCon and Black Hat, and Epstein replied with a description of conference tradecraft: "every sophisticated intelligence agency has its insertions in the crowd. chinese especially, how do you think they get the hacks. they are not creative, they convince the spectrum boys to play a game, as the boys are socially retarded they just play and give up their secrets re the kernel (not colonel). there is also an exchange for money for what is known as zero day exploits" [Finding #1232][EFTA02505281]. Bannon asked whether he could get an invitation to speak at the conferences [Finding #1232]. On cyber topics Epstein presented the subject-matter material; on White House personnel, Bannon did.

sections.title: The Wolff Channel, 2017
sections.content:
During 2017, before direct Bannon–Epstein contact is documented, Michael Wolff corresponded with Jeffrey Epstein while researching Fire and Fury [Finding #103]. The 2017 Bannon-related email traffic points to Wolff as the channel through which that material reached Epstein [Finding #99]. On April 27, 2017, Wolff emailed Epstein "Was with Bannon last night who was saying how much Trump liked deputy crown prince" — a reference to Mohammed bin Salman during the pre-Khashoggi period [Finding #103][EFTA02376015]. On August 14, 2017, during the West Wing struggle that preceded Bannon's August 18 departure, Wolff wrote: "McMaster and Murdoch met on Friday. Murdoch on the phone all weekend briefing against SB. Im tooting with him now. Hes not letting on that hes worried" [Finding #144][EFTA02641325]. By Wolff's own account in that message, he was physically with Bannon when he sent the note about Murdoch's activity [Finding #144].

Wolff also analyzed the Bannon relationship in emails to Epstein [Finding #136]. On January 13, 2018, when the Stormy Daniels story surfaced, Wolff wrote "Porn star - I think thats a Bannon leak" [EFTA02538373]. After Page Six published an August 2018 item about Bannon trying "to get on disgraced Jeffrey Epstein's good side," Wolff asked "Harmless. Do you think Bannon spilled?" Epstein replied "doorman"; Wolff responded "you should pay him off" [EFTA02604387][EFTA02604502]. The 2017–2019 records show Bannon using the addresses steve@arc-ent.com and BlackBerry/iMessage, with Wolff acting as the intermediary during 2017 and direct Bannon–Epstein email concentrated in 2018–2019 [Finding #99]. On November 5, 2018, Wolff proposed a media project built on the Bannon–Epstein pairing: "I was thinking of opening with you and Bannon talking about Trump. Would let you sound smart and offer what I think would be a crowd-pleasing perspective, and make you seem like a credible player — former friend of Trump, advisor to world leaders" [Finding #136][EFTA02538373]. In this framing Wolff positioned Epstein as a subject whose public image could be rebuilt through association with Bannon and access to Trump-era political material [Finding #99].

sections.title: European Movement Project, 2018
sections.content:
Bannon's principal post-White House initiative was "The Movement," an effort to build a pan-European populist alliance [Finding #125]. In March 2018, Bannon emailed Epstein from Italy: "My interview today lead page 1 story in largest paper in country. Heading to milan now to meet w salvini" [Finding #125][EFTA02514819]. Epstein tracked the tour in contemporaneous messages and proposed additional target countries in a single string — "kazaks mongolians senagleze austria norway strassberg osama Slovak montegegro ivory coast dubai qatr saudi kuwait yemen eritrea ethiopia kenya tunisia moldova" [Finding #125][EFTA02600289]. Benjamin Harnwell, director of the Dignitatis Humanae Institute at 44 Via delle Fornaci in Rome, forwarded Italian coverage of The Movement to Bannon, who routed it on to Epstein [Finding #125][EFTA02600072].

Epstein brokered several introductions tied to the European track. In November 2018 he arranged a London and Oxford meeting between Bannon and Eduardo Teodorani-Fabbri, an Italian-American financial intermediary who appears throughout the Epstein correspondence [Finding #121]. In the same month Epstein introduced Bannon to Jabor Al Thani by email — "Steve jabor - jabor - steve" — a Qatari contact who had been routing SoftBank-related material to Epstein since October 2016 [Finding #121]. These introductions placed Bannon at the junction of Epstein's Gulf and European contacts during the post-Khashoggi period [Finding #121].

A June 2019 iMessage captures Bannon asking Epstein directly: "Do u know anyone in Europe that wants to control the European Parliament and with it the EU — I need to get serious about taking on soros." Epstein replied: "There are lots of issues around this. Not for text" [Finding #108][EFTA01615902]. The broader thread shows the two discussing Gulf politics, George Nader's arrest, and cyber-tradecraft on the same iMessage platform without similar caveats [Finding #108][Finding #1227], suggesting Epstein's "not for text" restriction was specific to the European-influence topic rather than a general operational rule [Finding #108].

sections.title: Introductions at 9 East 71st Street
sections.content:
Between March and May 2018, Epstein's 9 East 71st Street residence hosted a series of dinners that paired Bannon with figures drawn from Epstein's diplomatic, legal, and academic contacts [Finding #121]. On March 15, 2018, Bannon joined a dinner with Terje Rod-Larsen, then president of the International Peace Institute, and an additional guest named Berge [Finding #121][EFTA02239420]. On March 22, Bannon dined with Ehud Barak, the former Israeli prime minister who was then developing Carbyne, a surveillance-technology company in which Epstein held an indirect interest [Finding #121][EFTA02239694]. On March 24, Bannon attended a Saturday meeting with Miroslav Lajcak (UN General Assembly President) and Kathryn Ruemmler, then a partner at Latham & Watkins and Epstein's personal attorney [Finding #121].

The pattern continued through spring 2018 [Finding #121]. On April 25, Bannon dined with Lajcak again. On April 26, the scheduled guests were Woody Allen and Soon-Yi Previn, "and maybe Steve Bannon" [Finding #121][EFTA02245252]. On May 11, Epstein sent himself a scheduling note listing "miro chomsky urenller bannon ehud terje" — Lajcak, Noam Chomsky, Ruemmler, Bannon, Barak, and Rod-Larsen — in a single entry [Finding #121]. On January 19, 2018, after a lunch, Epstein had introduced Bannon to Tom Pritzker, chairman of Hyatt Hotels and the Center for Strategic and International Studies, by email: "steve tom tom steve you guys figure it out" [Finding #121]. Epstein also arranged a March 24, 2018 breakfast for Bannon with Reid Weingarten, a white-collar defense attorney, with a follow-up breakfast scheduled for July 2019 [Finding #121].

The Chomsky introduction unfolded across roughly nine months [Finding #128]. On May 13, 2018, Chomsky wrote to Bannon via Epstein: "Jeffrey gave me your address, quite disappointed to have missed you the other night" [Finding #128][EFTA02620004]. By October 2018, Epstein was copying Chomsky and Bannon on the same message, writing "Steve Bannon who is copied on this email and I will come see you when you are back in arizona" [Finding #128]. In February 2019, a Bannon–Chomsky meeting in Tucson was arranged, with Valeria Chomsky replying "we look forward to meeting you" [Finding #128][EFTA02629996]. The breadth of the guest list across the dinner sequence — diplomats, a former head of government, a sitting UN body president, attorneys, a hotel-chain chairman, and an American linguist — indicates the role 9 East 71st Street played as a shared point of access rather than a single-issue salon [Finding #121][Finding #128].

sections.title: Documentary Project and Payments
sections.content:
The documented Bannon–Epstein film collaboration extends from at least July 2018 through June 2019, and, according to NBC News reporting cited in Finding #1228, involved approximately 15 hours of filmed interviews with Epstein [Finding #1228][Finding #132]. The first phase involved Bannon's own films. On July 23, 2018, Bannon emailed his producer Dan Fleuette "Get link to brother epstein asap" for the documentary American Carnage, which was shared via Vimeo with a password [Finding #132][EFTA02600591]. Epstein gave scene-level feedback, including "burning flag not relevant, john waynes beard explain, no one cares about Andrew family" [Finding #132][EFTA02600865]. Bannon wrote that Ari Emanuel had financed the film and that it was "officially in Venice Toronto and New York Film Festival" [Finding #132][EFTA02601609]. In August 2018, Bannon asked for the latest version of his subsequent film Trump@War to be sent to Epstein through Sean Bannon's ProtonMail [Finding #132].

The second phase concerned Epstein himself. According to NBC News reporting, Bannon described a three-phase image strategy for Epstein as "first we need to push back on the lies; then crush the pedo/trafficking narrative; then rebuild your image as philanthropist" [Finding #1228]. According to the same NBC account, Bannon arranged "media training" sessions at Epstein's residence marked "totally confidential," and Epstein's representatives used what Bannon called a "script" in responding to The New Yorker [Finding #1228]. An iMessage thread dated June 1–4, 2019 documents active filming, including "Exactly time the shot is fixed" (June 1) and "We got some great material yesterday" (June 2) [Finding #1225][EFTA01615902]. On June 2, 2019, Epstein wrote to Bannon: "I have told dan to send darren an invoice for 100k. I dont like you laying out money," routing the $100,000 payment through Darren Indyke [Finding #115][Finding #1225]. Bannon replied that he wanted to "make the overall deal with darren, not piecemeal," wording that suggests the total contemplated arrangement exceeded the $100,000 invoice [Finding #115].

Epstein also funded Bannon travel and sent gifts [Finding #115][Finding #142]. In May 2019, Epstein's staff booked AmEx Centurion flights for Bannon, Fleuette, and Dain Valverde from St. Thomas to Bergen, Norway via Fort Lauderdale, noting "if anyone gets a biz seat it would be Bannon" [Finding #115][EFTA02285032]. Epstein offered Bannon a trip to his private USVI island: "Happy to help coordinate tickets to Jeffrey's island off St Thomas" [Finding #115][EFTA02284819]. In January 2019, Epstein dispatched Apple Watches via FedEx to both Steve and Sean Bannon through Lesley Groff, whose staff followed up for weeks to confirm receipt; Sean Bannon eventually replied "Thank you Ill have him wear it next time he meets with JE" [Finding #142][EFTA02271436]. Sean Bannon's address at 210 A Street NE, Washington DC served as the delivery and ProtonMail relay point across multiple transactions [Finding #142].

sections.title: Legal Topics: Nader, Barr, Cambridge Analytica
sections.content:
Portions of the June 3, 2019 iMessage thread address then-active federal proceedings against George Nader, who had been arrested for child pornography in Dulles, Virginia [Finding #111][Finding #1227]. After Epstein shared a CNN link about the arrest, Bannon replied "Not cool" [Finding #111]. Epstein wrote "Mandatory minimum 15" [Finding #111]. When Bannon speculated "MBZ must have coughed him up," Epstein replied: "Nope. He was not extradited. He was duped. There is his bail hearing today. Pre trial detention. Currently in Brooklyn" [Finding #111][EFTA01615902]. Epstein added evidentiary detail: "Can you imagine. He actually literally had pictures of some kid fucking a goat. true!!!" [Finding #111]. The iMessage content matches information later confirmed in court filings about Nader's intake location and bail posture [Finding #111][Finding #1227], though the exchange does not establish how Epstein obtained the information.

The same thread contains comments on Epstein's own exposure [Finding #1227]. When the conversation turned to Prince Andrew and Donald Trump, Epstein wrote "recall prince andrews accuser came out of mara lago" [Finding #1227]. Bannon replied: "Cant believe nobody is making u the connective tissue" [Finding #1227][EFTA01615902]. Epstein deflected with "f and b only," describing his Mar-a-Lago role as food-and-beverage [Finding #1227]. Epstein was arrested five weeks later, on July 6, 2019, at Teterboro Airport [Finding #1227].

Epstein's inner circle tracked Bannon's separate legal vulnerabilities as well [Finding #1229]. On December 6, 2018, Richard Kahn of HBRK Associates forwarded Epstein a Daily Beast article covering Bannon's Senate Intelligence Committee testimony on Cambridge Analytica (EFTA02610736) [Finding #1229]. Read together, Kahn's November 2016 broker email [Finding #1235] and this December 2018 forward suggest Epstein's circle was monitoring Bannon's Russia-investigation exposure alongside the day-to-day correspondence [Finding #1229][Finding #1242]. That same day, according to a connection entry in the investigation record citing the "Re: Alex Acosta update | Power Line" email subject line, Epstein emailed Bannon "do you know bill barr. CIA" — hours after Donald Trump named William Barr as his Attorney General nominee. The Acosta subject line connects Barr's nomination to the U.S. Attorney who had approved Epstein's 2008 Non-Prosecution Agreement. Bannon's public legal history subsequent to these exchanges includes a 2020 federal indictment over the We Build the Wall crowdfunding (pardoned by President Trump in January 2021), a 2022 New York state indictment on the same underlying conduct (pending as of this writing), and a 2022 federal conviction on two counts of contempt of Congress that was vacated by the D.C. Circuit in 2024. The 2014–2019 Cambridge Analytica, White House, and Epstein-correspondence threads do not connect these later cases to the Epstein-era activity, and no documented operational link between them has been established [Finding #1242].

open_questions: Do the remaining hours of unreleased Bannon–Epstein filmed interviews beyond the roughly two hours made public contain additional on-the-record statements relevant to Epstein's network or Bannon's 2018–2019 activities?

What specific topics did Epstein's "Not for text" response to the European Parliament question exclude from the iMessage channel, and are those topics documented elsewhere in the corpus (email, calendar entries, in-person notes)?

What was the source of Epstein's June 3, 2019 knowledge of George Nader's manner of capture, bail-hearing schedule, and evidentiary details — and can contemporaneous DOJ press contact logs, defense counsel, or other correspondents in the Epstein corpus account for that knowledge?

Richard Kahn forwarded the Senate Intelligence Committee Cambridge Analytica coverage to Epstein rather than to Bannon [Finding #1229]; did Epstein's circle use that tracking in any outgoing message to Bannon, or was it purely internal monitoring?

What was the full scope of the "overall deal with darren" Bannon sought to negotiate with Darren Indyke in June 2019, and did financial flows from Epstein or Epstein-controlled entities to Bannon or his production companies extend beyond the $100,000 invoice and the AmEx-Centurion-booked travel?
